What is WRONG with you?! Going off and throwing a tantrum every single time you're wrong about something... You ought to be ashamed of yourself.

jp: ああ？そりゃな、俺だって完璧じゃねえからもしかするとミスがあって、既にスクラップになった連中の投票権が使われていたり、同じ奴の票が何度も重複して入っていることはあるかもしれない。

jp: でもミスがあったとしても結果に影響する程ではねえから、お前の仕事と違って！言っとくけど再集計しても結果は変わんねぇからな。
jp_grezzo: "でもミスがあったとしても結果に影響する程ではねえから、お前の仕事と違って！言っとくけど再集計しても結果は変わんねぇからな。"
en: But even if I made those mistakes, it wouldn't be enough make any difference, unlike all the mistakes YOU'VE made! And for your information, I'm not going to bother with a recount, since it wouldn't change a thing.
en_grezzo: "But even if I made those mistakes, it wouldn't be enough make any difference, unlike all the mistakes YOU'VE made! And for your information, I'm not going to bother with a recount, since it wouldn't change a thing."
it: Ma anche se avessi sbagliato, non basterebbe a cambiare il risultato, mica come gli errori che fai TU! E tanto per essere chiari, non ho nessuna intenzione di rifare lo spoglio: non cambierebbe niente.

jp: やめろ馬鹿！まるで俺らまで仕事ができねえみたいじゃねえか！お前と一緒にしないでくれるか？

jp: 確かに年々この部署の仕事は増えてきている。でも一機あたりの負担が増えようが、ぶっ壊れる奴が出ようが、それって今までやれてた仕事量から減らす理由にはならねえから。

en_grezzo: "Yeah, it's true that the workload in this division is increasing every year. But even if the workload per machine increases, or if some of those machines break down, all that work's still gotta get done somehow."
it: Sì, è vero che il carico di lavoro di questo reparto cresce ogni anno. Ma anche se aumenta il carico per macchina, e anche se qualche macchina va in pezzi, quel lavoro qualcuno lo deve fare lo stesso.

jp: だいたい、来て日の浅いお前にここの仕事のことが説明できるわけねえだろ。自分の仕事もちゃんと理解してないくせによ！上に掛け合うとかやめてくんない？お前みたいなのがいることが恥ずかしいんだけど。

You've barely even worked here for a few days and don't even know left from right! Cut the bullshit and quit trying to talk down to us! I'm ashamed of myself for even bothering to stand in the same room as a dipshit like you.
en_grezzo: "And if anyone's going to be the one who tells us how this joint gets run, why the hell does it have to be YOU of all people? You've barely even worked here for a few days and don't even know left from right! Cut the bullshit and quit trying to talk down to us! I'm ashamed of myself for even bothering to stand in the same room as a dipshit like you."
it: E se qualcuno deve venire a dirci come si manda avanti questo posto, perché diavolo dovresti essere proprio TU? Sei qui da quattro giorni e non distingui la destra dalla sinistra! Piantala con le stronzate e smettila di farci la lezione! Mi vergogno solo a stare nella stessa stanza di un pezzo di merda come te.

jp: おい、ちょっと座れよ。
jp_grezzo: "おい、ちょっと座れよ。"
en: Hey, you. Siddown.
en_grezzo: "Hey, you. Siddown."
it: Ehi, tu. Siediti.

jp: 床でいいから。よく話聞けよ。
jp_grezzo: "床でいいから。よく話聞けよ。"
en: I don't give a shit if you plant your ass on the floor. Listen to me reeeeal carefully.
en_grezzo: "I don't give a shit if you plant your ass on the floor. Listen to me reeeeal carefully."
it: Non me ne frega niente se ti piazzi per terra. Adesso ascoltami beeeene.

jp: お前さ、膨大なノウハウを口頭で言いあって覚えきれると思ってんのか？違うだろ。共有するにはそれぞれが資料を用意しなきゃいけないだろ。
jp_grezzo: "お前さ、膨大なノウハウを口頭で言いあって覚えきれると思ってんのか？違うだろ。共有するにはそれぞれが資料を用意しなきゃいけないだろ。"
en: Do you think you can cram all of that workplace-related knowledge into that pathetic brain of yours just by running your mouth for a while? Nope, you can't. In order to do that proper, you'd have to bring your own notes and materials to the meeting.
en_grezzo: "Do you think you can cram all of that workplace-related knowledge into that pathetic brain of yours just by running your mouth for a while? Nope, you can't. In order to do that proper, you'd have to bring your own notes and materials to the meeting."
it: Credi davvero di poterti ficcare tutto il mestiere in quel cervello da quattro soldi solo stando a chiacchierare? No che non ci riesci. Per farlo come si deve, ognuno dovrebbe portarsi appunti e materiale alla riunione.

jp: そりゃ何もわかってなくて比較的暇な新入りにはメリットが大きいかもしれないよ？でもそんなことする暇が他のみんなにあるように見えるか？…見えるんだろうなぁ！
jp_grezzo: "そりゃ何もわかってなくて比較的暇な新入りにはメリットが大きいかもしれないよ？でもそんなことする暇が他のみんなにあるように見えるか？…見えるんだろうなぁ！"
en: Of course, that would be a pretty sweet deal for a new kid like you with barely any work assignments and a lot of free time. But what about everyone else around here? ...Are you blind? Do those eyes of yours even WORK?
en_grezzo: "Of course, that would be a pretty sweet deal for a new kid like you with barely any work assignments and a lot of free time. But what about everyone else around here? ...Are you blind? Do those eyes of yours even WORK?"
it: Certo, per una matricola come te, che ha pochi incarichi e un sacco di tempo libero, sarebbe un affarone. Ma tutti gli altri qui dentro? ...Ma non ci vedi? Ce li hai due occhi che FUNZIONANO?

jp: 時間的に余裕がある状況ならまだわかる。でも知ってるか？お前以外がやってる仕事は全部期限があるの。お前だけだよ自分のペースで仕事できるのは。
jp_grezzo: "時間的に余裕がある状況ならまだわかる。でも知ってるか？お前以外がやってる仕事は全部期限があるの。お前だけだよ自分のペースで仕事できるのは。"
en: I can see where you're coming from if you have a lot of extra time on your hands. But you know what? Every single work assignment that everyone else in this place is busting their asses over has this thing called a \"deadline\". Might of heard of it, yeah? You're the only one in this joint who can work at their own pace.
en_grezzo: "I can see where you're coming from if you have a lot of extra time on your hands. But you know what? Every single work assignment that everyone else in this place is busting their asses over has this thing called a \"deadline\". Might of heard of it, yeah? You're the only one in this joint who can work at their own pace."
it: Capirei il discorso se uno avesse tempo da buttare. Ma sai che c'è? Ogni singolo incarico su cui tutti gli altri si stanno spaccando la schiena ha una cosa che si chiama \"scadenza\". Ne avrai sentito parlare, no? Qui dentro sei l'unica persona che può lavorare col proprio comodo.

jp: ノウハウを残すのは大事だよ。でも今の状況では超余計な作業だと思うんだけど？全体でどんくらい時間のロスが出ると思ってる？ちょっとお前考えが甘いよね。
jp_grezzo: "ノウハウを残すのは大事だよ。でも今の状況では超余計な作業だと思うんだけど？全体でどんくらい時間のロスが出ると思ってる？ちょっとお前考えが甘いよね。"
en: Yeah, I get that it's important to preserve your precious knowhow about the ins and outs of the job. But with things the way they are, isn't it just even more work that nobody actually needs to do? All you'll be doing is forcing everyone to adapt to YOUR schedule and constantly make up for lost time. Real genius plan you've got there. Quit overthinking things and get back to work.
en_grezzo: "Yeah, I get that it's important to preserve your precious knowhow about the ins and outs of the job. But with things the way they are, isn't it just even more work that nobody actually needs to do? All you'll be doing is forcing everyone to adapt to YOUR schedule and constantly make up for lost time. Real genius plan you've got there. Quit overthinking things and get back to work."
it: Sì, ho capito che è importante mettere per iscritto il prezioso mestiere. Ma messe così le cose, non è solo altro lavoro che nessuno ha bisogno di fare? L'unico risultato è costringere tutti ad adattarsi ai TUOI tempi e a rincorrere le ore perse. Un piano geniale, non c'è che dire. Smettila di farti tanti pensieri e torna a lavorare.

jp: お前そんなこと言って休みたいだけだろ。メンテナンスって簡単に言うけど結構時間かかるからね？目の前の仕事と将来的な健康、どっちが優先されるべきかわかる？優先順位くらい、考えて話せって言ってんだよ！！
jp_grezzo: "お前そんなこと言って休みたいだけだろ。メンテナンスって簡単に言うけど結構時間かかるからね？目の前の仕事と将来的な健康、どっちが優先されるべきかわかる？優先順位くらい、考えて話せって言ってんだよ！！"
en: You're just saying that so you can slack off, aren't you? You can blabble on about \"maintenance leave, maintenance leave\" all you want, but it's a pretty lengthy process, you know? What do you think should be more important: The job that needs to get done right now, or your health at some undefined point in the future? What I'm trying to drill into your dumbass brain is: figure out what YOUR priorities are and speak up for them!
en_grezzo: "You're just saying that so you can slack off, aren't you? You can blabble on about \"maintenance leave, maintenance leave\" all you want, but it's a pretty lengthy process, you know? What do you think should be more important: The job that needs to get done right now, or your health at some undefined point in the future? What I'm trying to drill into your dumbass brain is: figure out what YOUR priorities are and speak up for them!"
it: Lo dici solo per battere la fiacca, vero? Puoi ripetere \"manutenzione, manutenzione\" quanto ti pare, ma è una faccenda lunga, lo sai? Secondo te che cosa conta di più: il lavoro da consegnare adesso, o la tua salute in un domani che non si sa quando? Quello che sto cercando di ficcarti in quella zucca vuota è: decidi quali sono le TUE priorità e difendile!

jp: みんなも調子悪いみたいですよ
jp_grezzo: "みんなも調子悪いみたいですよ"
en: Everyone else seems to be in bad shape, too.
en_grezzo: "Everyone else seems to be in bad shape, too."
it: Anche gli altri non sembrano stare bene

jp: やばい病気かもしれないし念のため！
jp_grezzo: "やばい病気かもしれないし念のため！"
en: It could be a serious illness! Just in case!
en_grezzo: "It could be a serious illness! Just in case!"
it: Potrebbe essere una brutta malattia, per sicurezza!

jp: …お前にだけ言うけど、俺最近ちょっと調子悪いんだよね。部署全体の仕事の進みが遅くって遅くってまじ頭いてえの。だからこそ、のんびりメンテナンスなんて受けてる暇ないと思ってるから。
jp_grezzo: "…お前にだけ言うけど、俺最近ちょっと調子悪いんだよね。部署全体の仕事の進みが遅くって遅くってまじ頭いてえの。だからこそ、のんびりメンテナンスなんて受けてる暇ないと思ってるから。"
en: ...Between you and me, I've been feeling pretty under the weather myself lately. The whole division's been working so slowly that it's really starting to piss me off. But that's exactly the reason why I don't think we can afford to take a maintenance leave.
en_grezzo: "...Between you and me, I've been feeling pretty under the weather myself lately. The whole division's been working so slowly that it's really starting to piss me off. But that's exactly the reason why I don't think we can afford to take a maintenance leave."
it: ...Lo dico solo a te: da un po' non mi sento tanto bene neanch'io. Tutto il reparto va avanti così a rilento che mi fa girare le scatole. Ed è proprio per questo che non credo possiamo permetterci di andare in manutenzione.

jp: ハッ、たったこんだけの仕事しかしてない奴らが、調子悪くなるわけねえだろ！昔はもっと仕事量が多かったんだぞ。この程度で壊れるような奴はどっちにしろ使いもんにならねえからな！
jp_grezzo: "ハッ、たったこんだけの仕事しかしてない奴らが、調子悪くなるわけねえだろ！昔はもっと仕事量が多かったんだぞ。この程度で壊れるような奴はどっちにしろ使いもんにならねえからな！"
en: Pfft! How can they be in bad shape when they've barely got any work to do? We had to work a lot harder back in the day. If all they're going to do is piss off when given THIS amount of work, then they were all worthless dipshits from the start!
en_grezzo: "Pfft! How can they be in bad shape when they've barely got any work to do? We had to work a lot harder back in the day. If all they're going to do is piss off when given THIS amount of work, then they were all worthless dipshits from the start!"
it: Puah! Come fanno a stare male se non hanno quasi niente da fare? Ai miei tempi si lavorava molto di più. Se l'unica cosa che sanno fare è lamentarsi per QUESTA quantità di lavoro, allora non valevano niente fin dall'inizio!

jp: …。そう言われるとちょっと不安だな。
jp_grezzo: "…。そう言われるとちょっと不安だな。"
en: ...You're making me nervous, bringing that up.
en_grezzo: "...You're making me nervous, bringing that up."
it: ...A tirar fuori questa cosa mi metti in agitazione.

jp: 一応、みんな10秒で終わる簡易スキャンだけやって、引っかかった奴だけ精密検査受けることにするか。で、さらに引っかかった奴だけメンテナンス送りだ。それなら無駄ねえもんな。
jp_grezzo: "一応、みんな10秒で終わる簡易スキャンだけやって、引っかかった奴だけ精密検査受けることにするか。で、さらに引っかかった奴だけメンテナンス送りだ。それなら無駄ねえもんな。"
en: Alright, for now we'll do a quick scan, which will take just 10 seconds, and only those that raise any red flags will go through a full inspection. And after *that*, only the ones who fail the scan again will be sent away on maintenance leave. Sounds like a plan.
en_grezzo: "Alright, for now we'll do a quick scan, which will take just 10 seconds, and only those that raise any red flags will go through a full inspection. And after *that*, only the ones who fail the scan again will be sent away on maintenance leave. Sounds like a plan."
it: Va bene, per adesso facciamo una scansione rapida, dieci secondi, e solo chi risulta sospetto passa al controllo approfondito. E dopo *quello*, solo chi non lo supera va in manutenzione. Mi pare un buon piano.

jp: ま、そこまで引っかかるほど調子悪い奴なんて、いねえだろうけどな！
jp_grezzo: "ま、そこまで引っかかるほど調子悪い奴なんて、いねえだろうけどな！"
en: Well, it's not like I'D know anyone in such terrible shape that they'd fail a scan like that!
en_grezzo: "Well, it's not like I'D know anyone in such terrible shape that they'd fail a scan like that!"
it: Del resto, mica conosco qualcuno messo così male da non superare una scansione del genere!

jp: はい…
jp_grezzo: "はい…"
en: Yes...
it: Sì...

jp: アウトなやり方してるならアウトでしょ
jp_grezzo: "アウトなやり方してるならアウトでしょ"
en: If you're running things out of line, you're out of line.
en_grezzo: "If you're running things out of line, you're out of line."
it: Se il metodo è fuori norma, è fuori norma

jp: 確かにここのやり方は一般的に見たらアウトかもしれない。でも現実としてこうでもしなきゃ仕事が回らないってことくらいは、お前でもわかるだろ？
jp_grezzo: "確かにここのやり方は一般的に見たらアウトかもしれない。でも現実としてこうでもしなきゃ仕事が回らないってことくらいは、お前でもわかるだろ？"
en: I mean, sure, if you're comparing this place to your mommy's little old flower shop, then yeah, it might be just a bit out of line than what you're used to. But think about it. Even you understand that all of this is necessary to get the job done, right?
en_grezzo: "I mean, sure, if you're comparing this place to your mommy's little old flower shop, then yeah, it might be just a bit out of line than what you're used to. But think about it. Even you understand that all of this is necessary to get the job done, right?"
it: Cioè, certo, se paragoni questo posto al negozietto di fiori di tua madre, allora sì, magari qui si va un po' più fuori norma. Ma pensaci. Anche tu capisci che serve tutto questo per portare a casa il lavoro, no?

jp: おい、嘘つくな。本当にわかってんなら最初から言わねぇよな？チッ…ったくよぉ。お前と話してるとマジいらつくんだけど。なんとかなんねえの？
jp_grezzo: "おい、嘘つくな。本当にわかってんなら最初から言わねぇよな？チッ…ったくよぉ。お前と話してるとマジいらつくんだけど。なんとかなんねえの？"
en: Don't bullshit me. If you really believed something was wrong, you wouldn't have come crawling back to me to whine your ass off about it, right? Damnit... You're a real pain in the ass when I have talk to you. Can't you do something about that?
en_grezzo: "Don't bullshit me. If you really believed something was wrong, you wouldn't have come crawling back to me to whine your ass off about it, right? Damnit... You're a real pain in the ass when I have talk to you. Can't you do something about that?"
it: Non prendermi in giro. Se davvero pensassi che c'è qualcosa che non va, non verresti a frignare da me, giusto? Porca miseria... Sei una gran rottura di scatole da starti a sentire. Non è che puoi farci qualcosa?

jp: お前…帰れコノヤロウ！！！！
jp_grezzo: "お前…帰れコノヤロウ！！！！"
en: You... PIECE OF SHIT! GET THE HELL OUT OF HERE!!!!
en_grezzo: "You... PIECE OF SHIT! GET THE HELL OUT OF HERE!!!!"
it: Tu... PEZZO DI MERDA! FUORI DAI PIEDI!!!!

jp: この愚か者めが！！
jp_grezzo: "この愚か者めが！！"
en: You IMBECILE!!
en_grezzo: "You IMBECILE!!"
it: IMBECILLE!!

jp: 俺を倒したとして、自分の仕事も満足にできないやつが、俺のやっていた仕事までこなせるのか！！あ？少しは物を考えろ！！！
jp_grezzo: "俺を倒したとして、自分の仕事も満足にできないやつが、俺のやっていた仕事までこなせるのか！！あ？少しは物を考えろ！！！"
en: Even if you manage to take me down, is a pathetic runt like YOU who's so fed up with his own job EVER going to be capable of handling the ALL of the work that I'M responsible for!? You'd BETTER think twice before giving me that shit again!
en_grezzo: "Even if you manage to take me down, is a pathetic runt like YOU who's so fed up with his own job EVER going to be capable of handling the ALL of the work that I'M responsible for!? You'd BETTER think twice before giving me that shit again!"
it: Anche se riuscissi a farmi fuori, una mezza calzetta come TE, che è già stufa del proprio lavoro, sarebbe MAI in grado di reggere tutto il lavoro di cui rispondo IO?! Pensaci DUE volte prima di ripetermi certe stronzate!

jp: お前、割り当てられた仕事が終わったのか。なぁ？ちゃんとやればできる程度の仕事だろ。でもだいぶ無駄が多かったな。今度からはもっと早く終わらせろよ。
jp_grezzo: "お前、割り当てられた仕事が終わったのか。なぁ？ちゃんとやればできる程度の仕事だろ。でもだいぶ無駄が多かったな。今度からはもっと早く終わらせろよ。"
en: So you've finished your assigned work, huh? See, you can do it if you just try. But you wasted a lot of time. I'll be expecting you to get it done faster next time.
en_grezzo: "So you've finished your assigned work, huh? See, you can do it if you just try. But you wasted a lot of time. I'll be expecting you to get it done faster next time."
it: Allora hai finito il lavoro assegnato, eh? Visto che se ti impegni ci riesci. Però hai buttato via un sacco di tempo. La prossima volta mi aspetto che tu faccia più in fretta.

jp: じゃあ次の仕事渡しとくから。まぁこれでも飲んで頑張れよ。
jp_grezzo: "じゃあ次の仕事渡しとくから。まぁこれでも飲んで頑張れよ。"
en: Well, here's your next assignment. Take a swig of this, then get out there and make me proud.
en_grezzo: "Well, here's your next assignment. Take a swig of this, then get out there and make me proud."
it: Bene, ecco il prossimo incarico. Fatti una bella sorsata di questo, poi torna là fuori e fammi fare bella figura.

jp: 仕事Ａが増えた…。
jp_grezzo: "仕事Ａが増えた…。"
en: Work A has increased...
en_grezzo: "Work A has increased..."
it: Il Lavoro A è aumentato...

jp: 間違っているのはどこですか？
jp_grezzo: "間違っているのはどこですか？"
en: What specifically did I do wrong?
en_grezzo: "What specifically did I do wrong?"
it: Dove ho sbagliato di preciso?

jp: 間違えないように注意する点ってありますか？
jp_grezzo: "間違えないように注意する点ってありますか？"
en: What should do next time so I don't make mistakes?
en_grezzo: "What should do next time so I don't make mistakes?"
it: Come faccio a non sbagliare la prossima volta?

jp: お前ちょっと間違いが多すぎないか？やり直せ。いくら頑張っても結局間違えたら、その分は働いてないのと一緒だからな。
jp_grezzo: "お前ちょっと間違いが多すぎないか？やり直せ。いくら頑張っても結局間違えたら、その分は働いてないのと一緒だからな。"
en: Aren't you making a few too many mistakes? Start over. No matter how hard you try, making even a single mistake means you've spent all that time doing nothing useful at all.
en_grezzo: "Aren't you making a few too many mistakes? Start over. No matter how hard you try, making even a single mistake means you've spent all that time doing nothing useful at all."
it: Non stai facendo un po' troppi errori? Ricomincia da capo. Per quanto uno si impegni, basta un solo errore e tutto quel tempo non è servito a niente.

jp: 自分で見つけろ。俺が教えたら意味がない。
jp_grezzo: "自分で見つけろ。俺が教えたら意味がない。"
en: Figure it out yourself. If I have to point out every little thing for you, what are you even here for?
en_grezzo: "Figure it out yourself. If I have to point out every little thing for you, what are you even here for?"
it: Arrangiati. Se devo indicarti io ogni minima cosa, tu qui a fare che ci stai?

jp: 理解してやれば間違えないだろ！お前が理解せずになんとなくでやってるから全然合わないんだよ！わかんねえなら聞け！！！
jp_grezzo: "理解してやれば間違えないだろ！お前が理解せずになんとなくでやってるから全然合わないんだよ！わかんねえなら聞け！！！"
en: If you actually knew what you're supposed to be doing, you wouldn't be making all these mistakes! You're just flailing your arms around with no understanding of anything and are just hoping that it will all work out in the end! No wonder you've produced this absolute slop! If you don't understand what you're supposed to do, ASK!!!
en_grezzo: "If you actually knew what you're supposed to be doing, you wouldn't be making all these mistakes! You're just flailing your arms around with no understanding of anything and are just hoping that it will all work out in the end! No wonder you've produced this absolute slop! If you don't understand what you're supposed to do, ASK!!!"
it: Se avessi davvero capito che cosa devi fare, non faresti tutti questi errori! Ti agiti a vuoto senza capire niente e speri che alla fine si aggiusti tutto! Non c'è da stupirsi se è venuta fuori questa robaccia! Se non capisci che cosa devi fare, CHIEDI!!!

jp: 仕事Ｂが増えた…。
jp_grezzo: "仕事Ｂが増えた…。"
en: Work B has increased...
en_grezzo: "Work B has increased..."
it: Il Lavoro B è aumentato...

jp: 前のままでもよくないですか
jp_grezzo: "前のままでもよくないですか"
en: Isn't it better to leave it as it is?
en_grezzo: "Isn't it better to leave it as it is?"
it: Non è meglio lasciarlo com'era?

jp: 今後の拡張性も考えた形式に変えましょう
jp_grezzo: "今後の拡張性も考えた形式に変えましょう"
en: Let's modify the format so it can be easily changed later.
en_grezzo: "Let's modify the format so it can be easily changed later."
it: Cambiamo formato, così poi si modifica facilmente

jp: 仕事Ｂだけどよ、あれやり方変えろよ。書式も変えて項目追加しとけ。
jp_grezzo: "仕事Ｂだけどよ、あれやり方変えろよ。書式も変えて項目追加しとけ。"
en: So for Work B, forget everything about what you've done. Do it differently. Also, change to a different document format and add another section.
en_grezzo: "So for Work B, forget everything about what you've done. Do it differently. Also, change to a different document format and add another section."
it: Allora, per il Lavoro B, dimentica tutto quello che hai fatto. Rifallo in un altro modo. E poi cambia il formato del documento e aggiungi un'altra sezione.

jp: 今まではあれで通っていたかもしれないけど、そんなの理由にならねえからな！つべこべ言わずにさっさと取り掛かれ！！！
jp_grezzo: "今まではあれで通っていたかもしれないけど、そんなの理由にならねえからな！つべこべ言わずにさっさと取り掛かれ！！！"
en: That may have gotten you through your life so far, but it's not gonna fly around here! Shut the hell up and get on with it already!!!
en_grezzo: "That may have gotten you through your life so far, but it's not gonna fly around here! Shut the hell up and get on with it already!!!"
it: Forse fino a oggi te la sei cavata così, ma qui dentro non attacca! Chiudi il becco e datti da fare, una buona volta!!!

jp: じゃあ任せた。そんなことにあんまり時間かけるなよ。
jp_grezzo: "じゃあ任せた。そんなことにあんまり時間かけるなよ。"
en: Well, I'll leave it to you, then. But don't waste my time screwing around with it for too long.
en_grezzo: "Well, I'll leave it to you, then. But don't waste my time screwing around with it for too long."
it: E va bene, allora te ne occupi tu. Ma non farmi perdere tempo a rigirartelo troppo a lungo.

jp: 仕事Ｃが増えた…。
jp_grezzo: "仕事Ｃが増えた…。"
en: Work C has increased...
en_grezzo: "Work C has increased..."
it: Il Lavoro C è aumentato...

jp: わかりました…
jp_grezzo: "わかりました…"
en: Understood...
en_grezzo: "Understood..."
it: Va bene...

jp: 他の仕事あるんですけど…
jp_grezzo: "他の仕事あるんですけど…"
en: Uhh, I still have other work to do...
en_grezzo: "Uhh, I still have other work to do..."

en_grezzo: "You, hurry up and help out with my work too."

jp: ハァ～…大丈夫なんだろうな？ちゃっちゃと成果あげてくれよなホントに。

it: *sospiro*... Ma posso davvero fidarmi di te? Vedi di portare dei risultati, o ti salto addosso.

jp: 何勘違いしてんだ？俺はお前になるべく仕事が回らないように配慮してんだからな？このくらい合間にやればいいだろうが！ええ？お前マジで自分のことしか考えてないよな！！！

en: What the hell is wrong with you? I'm working my ass off over here to make sure that YOUR ungrateful ass takes on as few extra assignments as possible, got it? The least you can do is work on this in the meantime! Why, you little... You really think you're some kind of special snowflake, don't you?!
en_grezzo: "What the hell is wrong with you? I'm working my ass off over here to make sure that YOUR ungrateful ass takes on as few extra assignments as possible, got it? The least you can do is work on this in the meantime! Why, you little... You really think you're some kind of special snowflake, don't you?!"
it: Ma che diavolo ti prende? Io qui mi sto spaccando la schiena per fare in modo che a TE, che non ringrazi mai, tocchino meno incarichi in più possibile, chiaro? Il minimo che puoi fare è portare avanti questo, intanto! Ma guarda te... Ti credi chissà chi, vero?!

jp_grezzo: "すいません"

jp_grezzo: "やり方を教えてくれないからです"

en_grezzo: "They're refusing to teach me what to do."

jp: おい、なんでこんなに時間かかってるんだ！！！
jp_grezzo: "おい、なんでこんなに時間かかってるんだ！！！"
en: What the HELL is taking you so long!!!
en_grezzo: "What the HELL is taking you so long!!!"
it: Ma che DIAVOLO ci metti tanto a fare!!!

jp: 俺がここに来たときはお前の3倍以上の仕事持っていたんだぞ！基準は甘々でやり直しとかはなかったけどよ。お前だいぶ恵まれている方だから。
jp_grezzo: "俺がここに来たときはお前の3倍以上の仕事持っていたんだぞ！基準は甘々でやり直しとかはなかったけどよ。お前だいぶ恵まれている方だから。"
en: When I came here, I had THREE TIMES the workload that you have! The standards at the time were pretty lax, so I didn't have to constantly redo everything, but YOU'RE the lucky one here.
en_grezzo: "When I came here, I had THREE TIMES the workload that you have! The standards at the time were pretty lax, so I didn't have to constantly redo everything, but YOU'RE the lucky one here."
it: Ai miei tempi il carico di lavoro era TRE VOLTE quello che hai tu! Allora i criteri erano molto più larghi, quindi non c'era da rifare tutto ogni volta: la fortuna qui è TUA.

jp: そうやってすぐ言い訳する癖を直せ。整理整頓は大事だけどそれに時間かけすぎなんだよお前！時間配分ができてねえよなぁ、時間配分がよ。
jp_grezzo: "そうやってすぐ言い訳する癖を直せ。整理整頓は大事だけどそれに時間かけすぎなんだよお前！時間配分ができてねえよなぁ、時間配分がよ。"
en: Do yourself a favor and quit immediately making excuses like that. Organization is important, but you're spending too much time on it! Write up a proper schedule and stick to it, for the love of...
en_grezzo: "Do yourself a favor and quit immediately making excuses like that. Organization is important, but you're spending too much time on it! Write up a proper schedule and stick to it, for the love of..."
it: Fatti un favore e smettila subito di tirare fuori scuse del genere. Mettere in ordine è importante, ma ci stai perdendo troppo tempo! Fatti una tabella di marcia come si deve e rispettala, per l'amor del...

jp: 反抗的だよなぁ、お前！子供みたいなこと言ってんじゃねえぞ！この忙しい時にやり方を一から教えなきゃいけないのか？普通に考えてわかるだろうが！！！
jp_grezzo: "反抗的だよなぁ、お前！子供みたいなこと言ってんじゃねえぞ！この忙しい時にやり方を一から教えなきゃいけないのか？普通に考えてわかるだろうが！！！"
en: What a defiant little brat you are! That's right, you're nothing but a whiny-ass kid. Do I really have to take time out of MY busy schedule to educate YOUR ass about YOUR responsibilities from the ground up? If you'd just THINK for once you'd figure it out!!!
en_grezzo: "What a defiant little brat you are! That's right, you're nothing but a whiny-ass kid. Do I really have to take time out of MY busy schedule to educate YOUR ass about YOUR responsibilities from the ground up? If you'd just THINK for once you'd figure it out!!!"
it: Ma senti che insolenza! Esatto, sei solo una piaga che frigna in continuazione. Devo davvero rubare tempo alla MIA agenda per insegnarti da zero quali sono le TUE responsabilità? Basterebbe che ci PENSASSI una volta e ci arriveresti anche tu!!!

jp: この仕事辞めたいです
jp_grezzo: "この仕事辞めたいです"

en_grezzo: "I want to quit this job."

jp: 機械の神もこのような職場をお許しにはならない！
jp_grezzo: "機械の神もこのような職場をお許しにはならない！"
en: Not even the God of Machine would allow this workplace to exist!
en_grezzo: "Not even the God of Machine would allow this workplace to exist!"
it: Nemmeno il dio delle macchine tollererebbe un posto così!

jp: ちゃんと自覚してるんだろうな？配属された瞬間からお前は社畜なんだ！お前はこの仕事に尽くさなければならない！これは神の意思だ！！！
jp_grezzo: "ちゃんと自覚してるんだろうな？配属された瞬間からお前は社畜なんだ！お前はこの仕事に尽くさなければならない！これは神の意思だ！！！"
en: You're fully aware of what you've gotten into, right? From the moment you were assigned here, you're a corporate drone! Your existence is predicated on your utmost devotion to the company! This is the will of God!
en_grezzo: "You're fully aware of what you've gotten into, right? From the moment you were assigned here, you're a corporate drone! Your existence is predicated on your utmost devotion to the company! This is the will of God!"
it: Sai benissimo che cosa ti aspetta, no? Dal momento in cui ti hanno assegnato qui, sei una bestia da soma dell'azienda! La tua esistenza si regge sulla devozione assoluta alla ditta! È la volontà divina!

jp: おい…なんだその顔は。はいはい言っとけばいいと思ってんだろ！しんどそうにしてるけど俺だってお前と好きでしゃべってるわけじゃねえからな！！！
jp_grezzo: "おい…なんだその顔は。はいはい言っとけばいいと思ってんだろ！しんどそうにしてるけど俺だってお前と好きでしゃべってるわけじゃねえからな！！！"
en: Don't give me that look. You think you can just say whatever you want! You just look like you're having a hard time, but it's not like I'm thrilled to talk to you either!
en_grezzo: "Don't give me that look. You think you can just say whatever you want! You just look like you're having a hard time, but it's not like I'm thrilled to talk to you either!"
it: E non guardarmi con quella faccia. Credi di poter dire tutto quello che ti pare! Fai la parte di chi se la passa male, ma nemmeno a me fa piacere stare qui a parlarti!

jp: あのなぁ…他の仕事だって楽なわけじゃねえから。このくらいで音を上げていたらどこに行っても通用しないからな！
jp_grezzo: "あのなぁ…他の仕事だって楽なわけじゃねえから。このくらいで音を上げていたらどこに行っても通用しないからな！"
en: You do realize that this is just how things work, right? No matter where you choose to work next, it's not going to get any easier. If this is all it takes for you to start whining your ass off, you have no hope of making it in this world!
en_grezzo: "You do realize that this is just how things work, right? No matter where you choose to work next, it's not going to get any easier. If this is all it takes for you to start whining your ass off, you have no hope of making it in this world!"
it: Ti rendi conto che il mondo funziona così, vero? Dovunque tu vada a lavorare dopo, non sarà più facile. Se basta questo per farti frignare, non hai nessuna speranza di cavartela là fuori!

jp: 社畜に神はいないッ！！ロボットには…労働基準もないッ！！
jp_grezzo: "社畜に神はいないッ！！ロボットには…労働基準もないッ！！"
en: A corporate drone has no need for God!! And there's no such thing as labor standards for robots...!!
en_grezzo: "A corporate drone has no need for God!! And there's no such thing as labor standards for robots...!!"
it: Una bestia da soma non ha bisogno di nessun dio!! E per i robot non esiste nessuno statuto dei lavoratori...!!
